daemonize.description: Whether to run JupyterHub as a background daemon process.

cwd.description: Base directory for JupyterHub configuration, logs, and data files.

db_url.description: Database connection string. Use SQLite for single-node deployments; PostgreSQL or MySQL for production scaling.

authenticator_class.description: Authenticator backend class to handle user login (e.g., PAM, OAuth, LDAP, or custom).

spawner_class.description: Spawner backend to launch user servers (e.g., local process, Docker, Kubernetes).

concurrent_spawn_limit.description: Maximum number of user servers that may be spawned concurrently.

db_archive_max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for database entries before archiving. Set to 0 to disable.

proxy_api_ip.description: IP address for the ConfigurableHTTPProxy's internal API.

proxy_api_port.description: Port for the ConfigurableHTTPProxy's internal API.

hub_ip.description: IP address the Hub binds to (usually localhost or internal network).

hub_port.description: Port the Hub binds to for internal communication.

base_url.description: Public base URL path for the JupyterHub (e.g., '/hub/' or 'https://hub.example.com/')

ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file. Leave empty to disable HTTPS.

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file. Required if using SSL/TLS.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle user server is stopped. 0 = disabled.

docker_image.description: Default Docker image used to spawn single-user servers (used only if spawner supports Docker).

items.description: OAuth configuration key-value pairs (e.g., for GitHub, Google).

value.description: Configuration value as valid Python literal (e.g., '"abc123"', 'True', '["a", "b"]')

oauth_configs.description: List of OAuth configuration overrides (e.g., client ID, secret, allowed domains).

admin.description: Whether this service has admin access to JupyterHub API

services.description: List of JupyterHub services to register (e.g., culling, metrics).
